## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Use Case
What problem does this feature solve?
*As a [type of user], I want [capability] so that [benefit/outcome].*

## 💡 Proposed Solution & UI/UX Experience
Describe how you envision the feature working inside the app:
- Which screen or feature area (`:feature:scanner`, `:feature:ocr-edit`, `:feature:viewer`, `:feature:redaction`, etc.)?
- How should the user interact with it?

## 🔒 Privacy & Offline Considerations
- [ ] This feature operates **100% on-device** and does not require cloud data transmission.

## 📌 Alternative Solutions Considered
Describe any alternative workflows, third-party libraries, or workarounds you've considered.

## 📎 Additional Context / Mockups
Add any mockups, diagrams, or references here.
